author: Maya Rodriguez

review_comments: Liam Chen (2026-02-16): Can you clarify how shape_guard impacts tail latency? I want numbers for worst-case guard trips.

Priya Patel (2026-02-17): Suggest moving the KV-cache delay threshold to a per-model tunable. Otherwise LGTM.
Maya Rodriguez (2026-02-17): Done — added a per-model config and runtime toggle, documented in tools/console/graph_warmup_toggles.md
Ethan Moore (2026-02-18): I saw flaky failure on cuda-integration on a different CUDA minor; added a guard around kernel selection for older drivers.
Maya Rodriguez (2026-02-18): Addressed — now we probe driver capabilities before enabling specialized kernels.
release_notes: Adaptive warmup and shape-guarding for CUDA-graph replay: reduces capture-related regressions and adds conservative kernel fallback during unstable warmup periods. Adds telemetry metrics for graph capture health.
